config/settings.yml.source:
server:
  host: localhost
  port: 8080
  timeouts:
    connect: 30
    read: 60
database:
  primary:
    url: postgresql://db.example.com/prod
    pool_size: 10
  replicas:
    - url: postgresql://replica1.example.com/prod
    - url: postgresql://replica2.example.com/prod
logging:
  level: DEBUG
  handlers:
    - console
    - file

services:
  web:
